header.marketHours: Trades {open} to {close}, {zone}. Public holidays are not accounted for.

chart.title: {symbol} price
chart.panEarlier: Show the previous stretch of history
chart.panLater: Show the next stretch of history

keyInfo.title: Key information
keyInfo.distributionsTitle: Read from the price history: the adjusted close parts from the quoted close whenever a distribution is paid. Observed from data, not declared by the issuer.

about.title: About
about.noDescription: No description has been saved for this security.

performance.title: Security performance
performance.subject: How the instrument itself has moved, whether or not you held it. What your own position made is under Total return.
performance.empty: Not enough price history to measure a return yet.
performance.excludesDividendsTitle: This provider supplies no adjusted-close series, so these returns are measured on price alone. For a fund that pays out, they understate the return by its yield.
performance.cumulativeNote: 3Y and 5Y are cumulative over the whole period, not per year.

rollingReturns.title: Rolling returns
rollingReturns.subject: Every holding period of this length in the fund's NAV history: how it went at worst, typically and at best, and how often it ended positive.
rollingReturns.loadFailed: Rolling returns could not be loaded.

status.INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY: The stored NAV history is shorter than this period.
status.ALL_WINDOWS_MISSING: No period could be measured: {count, plural, one {its start date has} other {every one of its {shown} start dates has}} no NAV within 14 days.
status.NO_PRICE_HISTORY: No NAV history is stored for this fund yet.

rollingReturns.incompleteHeading: Some periods could not be measured
rollingReturns.incomplete: {period}: {count, plural, one {{shown} period has} other {{shown} periods have}} no NAV within 14 days of its start date, so the figures describe only the periods that could be measured. Missing periods end {ranges}.
rollingReturns.gapMore: {count, plural, one {and {shown} more range} other {and {shown} more ranges}}
rollingReturns.stale: The latest NAV is from {date}, more than 14 days ago. The NAV feed may be behind, so recent periods are missing.
rollingReturns.excluded: {count, plural, one {{shown} NAV row was left out because it was} other {{shown} NAV rows were left out because they were}} zero, negative or dated in the future.
rollingReturns.basisNote: 1-year figures are absolute; 3- and 5-year figures are annualized (p.a.).
rollingReturns.idcwNote: Based on NAV. For IDCW (dividend) plans, payouts are not added back.

positionInfo.title: Position info
positionInfo.realizedMixed: Realized in {currencies}, so not added up
positionInfo.totalReturnTitle: Unrealized gain, plus what you realized on sales and received in income, less fees, over the capital you put in. A simple return on that capital: it is not annualized and does not weight tranches by how long you held them.

closed.title: Position closed
closed.description: You no longer hold this security. Its history stays available below.

empty.noPositionHint: You have not recorded any transactions for this security yet.
empty.noAccounts: This security is not held in any account.

weightings.title: Breakdown
weightings.sectorEmpty: No sector breakdown is stored. Artha fills this in from the provider for funds and ETFs.
weightings.countryEmpty: No country breakdown is stored. You can enter one when editing the security.
weightings.assetClassEmpty: No asset class breakdown is stored yet.

documents.title: Documents
documents.loadFailed: Could not load the documents for this security

empty.title: No documents yet
empty.description: Keep the paperwork for this security in one place: its factsheet, its KIID, a prospectus, an annual report, a tax slip. Each one is a link you can open straight from here.

form.dateHint: The date on the document itself, not today. Leave it empty if it has none.

validation.urlScheme: The address must start with http:// or https://

delete.title: Delete document?
delete.message: This removes the link to "{name}". The document itself is not touched.

news.title: News mentioning {symbol}
news.subject: The provider files a story against every ticker it names, so some of these are about another company that mentions this one.
news.loadFailed: Could not load the news for this security
news.unsupportedProvider: The quote provider for this security supplies no news. Switching it to Yahoo, when editing the security, brings headlines here.

empty.title: No headlines right now
empty.description: Nothing has been published against this symbol recently. The list refreshes when you come back to it.
